heading: Questions people ask before they buy

items.question: What does 916 hallmark mean?
items.answer: 916 is the fineness of 22-karat gold: 916 parts per thousand, or 91.6% pure. Every piece sold in the UAE must carry a hallmark under Federal Law No. 11 of 2015, and Dubai Municipality’s Dubai Central Laboratory inspects jewellers to check it. The stamp is applied after assay, so purity is verified rather than promised.

items.question: How do I know a diamond is genuine?
items.answer: Every diamond is tested on a thermal and electrical tester at the counter before it is sold, and larger stones come with an independent laboratory grading report. Ask to watch the test; most customers do.

items.question: What does lifetime maintenance cover?
items.answer: Cleaning, polishing, stone tightening and minor repairs for as long as you own the piece. Bring it in whenever it needs attention; there is no charge for routine care.

items.question: How does the 0% deduction gold exchange work?
items.answer: Bring any old gold. We test its purity in front of you and credit its full gold value, by weight, at the day’s rate against a new piece, with no deduction for wear or design. Making charges and VAT apply to the new piece; terms for cash sales differ, so ask before you come.

items.question: What is the return policy?
items.answer: Unworn pieces in their original condition, with the invoice and certificate, can be returned within 14 days of purchase. Customised, engraved and resized pieces are exchange-only. This is our own commitment and does not limit your rights for defective goods under UAE Federal Law No. 15 of 2020.
